knowledge_basis.scope: Communication can carry malicious instructions; not every anomalous act is transferable instruction content.
Information provenance and authorization specifications are distinct. Separate latent channels are our modeling choice, not this paper's algorithm or an identified causal graph.

boundaries: Authorization state is a node-level accumulated hazard hypothesis, not an action-scoped valid-grant proof.
Ordinary messages and delegation currently transmit only the information channel; delegated authority, scope attenuation and approvals require a future explicit mechanism.
Both state types persist; review, sanitization and revocation recovery are not implemented.
Labels remain terminal episode outcomes. State marginals are not independently validated risk-type probabilities.
Batch/prefix compiler only in this prototype; the existing live JointRiskStream still uses the original model.
The current v3 synthetic data has no message after privileged dispatch, so it cannot validate the corrected transport distinction.
